bead.title: opencode: add to capability_matrix.json and primary-harness baseline
bead.description:
PROBLEM: opencode has no row in internal/harnesses/capability_matrix.json (which carries codex, claude, claude-tui, gemini) and is excluded from docs/helix/02-design/primary-harness-capability-baseline.md (still labeled "secondary follow-up", baseline lines 18-20). Without a matrix row + conformance-evidence bindings, opencode's CONTRACT-004 status is untracked and its parity work is invisible to the matrix tests.

ROOT CAUSE: documentation/registration gap; opencode was deferred as secondary.

PROPOSED FIX: Add an opencode harness object to capability_matrix.json with Harness and ModelDiscoveryHarness supported rows bound to existing conformance tests (TestOpenCodeRunnerHarnessConformance, TestOpenCodeRunnerModelDiscoveryConformance, conformance_test.go:10,14) and QuotaHarness/AccountHarness marked n/a (matching doc.go). Add an opencode row to the baseline table reflecting post-parity status (Run/FinalText/ProgressEvents/ToolEvents/TokenUsage pass; QuotaStatus n/a). Verify against capability_matrix_test.go (it special-cases claude-tui; ensure adding opencode does not trip the evidence-ID requirement — opencode rows bind to test evidence, not billing cassettes).

NON-SCOPE: code changes to the runner.
bead.acceptance:
1. capability_matrix.json contains an opencode entry whose supported capabilities each carry non-empty test evidence IDs.
2. Matrix-validation tests stay green: cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && GOPRIVATE=github.com/easel/* GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test ./internal/harnesses/... -run CapabilityMatrix -count=1 -timeout 120s.
3. primary-harness-capability-baseline.md has an opencode row.
4. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && GOPRIVATE=github.com/easel/* GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test ./internal/harnesses/opencode/... -count=1 -timeout 120s green. Do NOT run `go test ./...` (HANGS).
5. lefthook run pre-commit passes.

The evidence_id requirement in TestCapabilityMatrixEvidenceIDRequired is gated on harness.Name == 'claude-tui' (capability_matrix_test.go:63), so opencode entries using plain 'test' evidence with no evidence_id field will not trip that check. TestHarnessCapabilityMatrixEvidenceResolution iterates all harnesses and calls validateTestEvidenceExists, which parses the opencode/ package directory — the conformance test functions are present there and will resolve. TestHarnessCapabilityMatrixValidation and the SupportedLimitIDs/SupportedAliases tests enumerate explicit cases (claude, codex, gemini only) and are unaffected by a new opencode matrix entry. validateMethodExists has no opencode case, but the bead correctly specifies test-type evidence only, avoiding that path entirely.
